title: betula alba var. fontqueri
intro: Betula alba var. fontqueri, commonly known as Spanish white birch, is a variety of birch tree native to the Iberian Peninsula. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Betula alba var. fontqueri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects.
